info.title: FluentCart API
info.description: Complete REST API documentation for FluentCart e-commerce platform

post.description:
Trigger a one-click install of the FluentHub adapter plugin, which is required for the MCP endpoint to work. The free FluentCart plugin can only detect and trigger this install — the actual installer logic lives in a Fluent Pro plugin (FluentCart Pro, or any other Fluent product) that hooks the `fluent_toolkit/*` contract. If no Pro plugin is active, this returns the manual download link instead of installing anything.

**Required permission:** `is_super_admin`

200.description: FluentHub installed and activated, or a manual-install link was returned.

example.message: FluentHub installed and activated. The MCP endpoint is ready.
FluentHub installed and activated. The MCP endpoint is ready.

value.message: FluentHub installed and activated. The MCP endpoint is ready.

422.description: Either the current WordPress user lacks the `install_plugins` capability (regardless of the `is_super_admin` route policy — the controller re-checks independently), or no Pro plugin supports automatic install and a manual download link is returned instead. Both cases use the framework's default `sendError()` status of 422; distinguish them by the presence of `toolkit_download_url`.
